lines.text: The Spirit sets Ezekiel on his feet, and the LORD sends him to a rebellious nation of Israelites.
The LORD tells Ezekiel not to be afraid, though briers and thorns surround him and he dwells among serpents.
The LORD tells Ezekiel to eat a scroll of lamentation, mourning, and woe, and it tastes as sweet as honey.
The LORD says He will make Ezekiel's forehead like a diamond, harder than granite.
The Spirit takes Ezekiel away, and he comes to the exiles at Tel-abib by the River Kebar.
